title: fix: prioritize exact WebSocket ingress over web root
body:
## Scope
Minimal chart-only Traefik router-priority fix. Split the existing root web route (priority 10) and exact `/ws` route (priority 100) into separate Ingresses. Retain the existing `ryggattack` certificate issuer owner and share `ryggattack-tls` without another issuer annotation. No runtime, image/tag, Dockerfile, timeout or workflow changes; appVersion remains the published paired `sha-205d048`.

## Verification
- Strict test-first RED: updated real-Helm chart regression failed on the old single Ingress (exit 1, expected split assertion).
- GREEN: same regression passed after the minimal template change; existing security/private-management/publication assertions preserved.
- `helm lint charts/ryggattack --strict` passed; rendered full chart passed `kubectl apply --dry-run=server` (no deployment).
- All local non-build CI checks passed: refresh-rate, rooms UI, resilience/network harnesses, Pages redirect, paired chart-version update, container-network and portable-builder contracts; additional live-deployment helper tests passed.
- Parent-provided actual-controller diagnostic proof: combined route `/ws` 404 nginx -> separate priority-100 exact route 101; `/ws/metrics` remains 404. Distinct temporary HTTP Host only (canonical trusted TLS SNI), canonical production Ingress/certs unchanged, both temporary Ingresses removed/read back. Evidence and RED/GREEN logs are under `docs/online-deployment-evidence/ingress-priority/`.

## Remaining gate / operator handoff
Exact PR-head remote CI (Rust/clippy/runtime/headless, WASM and Helm jobs) must pass before merge. No heavy local Rust/WASM build was run for this unchanged-runtime fix. This PR is NOT merged or deployed and does not claim canonical public acceptance. Trusted canonical browser/WSS room/start/reconnect replay remains blocked until reviewed main-chart rollout.

After exact-head CI and independent review, the authorized parent operator should use the chart-only merge pattern with `[skip ci]` in the merge commit message to avoid republishing unchanged runtime images. Do not skip PR CI.
